SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.

3. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   C. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   B. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

7. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   C. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   D. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   C. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.

9. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   B. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   D. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

11. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   D. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   C. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   D. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fieldwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa 5 5.2 The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Righ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Rights 5 5.4 African Diasporas 5 5.5 Citiz and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
